title: Dashboard
description: ObserveSpec v0: one SlashObserve dashboard. Absent fields mean the default. Frozen for milestone 1 (Ishan, 2026-10-18).

timePicker.description: What the time picker offers: hidden removes it, refreshIntervals replaces the auto-refresh choices and quickRanges the preset ranges. A refresh that is not in refreshIntervals is still allowed.

liveNow.description: Refresh the dashboard every few seconds until a refresh interval is chosen, as Grafana's live now redraws time charts continuously.

timezone.description: browser, utc or an IANA zone such as Asia/Kolkata. Relative times (now/d, now-1d) resolve in this zone.

weekStart.description: The first day of the week for now/w. Absent means monday.

fiscalYearStartMonth.description: The month the fiscal year starts in for now/fy and now/fQ, 0 (January) to 11 (December). Absent means 0.

nowDelay.description: How far behind the real time now is for every relative time, such as 30s or 1m.

cursorSync.description: How hovering one time chart shows on the others: off, crosshair (the hovered time is marked on every time chart) or tooltip (their tooltips open too). Grafana's graphTooltip 0, 1 and 2.

panels.description: At most 200 panels in total, row children included; ids are unique across all of them.

timeExpression.description: Relative (now, now-6h, now+1d, now-1d/d, now/fy for the start of the fiscal year, now/fQ for the fiscal quarter) or absolute RFC 3339 time.

datasourceUid.title: DatasourceUid
datasourceUid.description: A configured datasource uid; its type comes from the server's registry.

datasourceRef.title: DatasourceRef
datasourceRef.description: A configured datasource uid, or ${name} naming a datasource variable declared in variables (before this variable, when used by one); queries then run on the datasource selected in that variable, and macros follow its datasourceType.

intervalRef.title: IntervalRef
intervalRef.description: A minimum step such as 30s, or ${name} naming an interval variable; queries then use the step selected in that variable.

color.title: Color
color.description: A semantic color (ok, info, warning, critical) or a #rrggbb hex color.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: A Grafana unit id, or a custom suffix:, prefix:, time:, si:, count: or currency: unit.

aggregateReducer.title: AggregateReducer
aggregateReducer.description: A reducer for a grouping step: every reducer, and uniqueValues, which lists the distinct values as text.

selection.title: Selection
selection.description: Default selection: one value, several for a multi variable, or $__all.

applyToAll.description: ClickHouse only: also filter every query on this datasource that does not use this variable, on each table the query reads.

gridPos.title: GridPos
gridPos.description: Position on the 24-column grid; x + w must not exceed 24.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Only the first step may omit value; it is then the base color below every other step.

mapping.title: Mapping
mapping.description: Value mapping; needs text, color or both.

oneClick.description: A data link on a stat, gauge, bar gauge or table cell that makes the whole tile, bar, gauge or cell the link when it is the only data link there.

link.title: Link
link.description: Panel, dashboard or data link; ${var} and ${__data.fields.x} are interpolated.

dashboardLink.title: DashboardLink
dashboardLink.description: A dashboard link, either to an address (title and url) or, with type dashboards, to the other dashboards that carry every one of the tags (all other dashboards when there are none), shown inline or as one dropdown. keepTime adds the current from and to and includeVars the var-* selections.

fieldProps.title: FieldProps
fieldProps.description: Display properties shared by a panel and its overrides.

fieldMinMax.description: Gauges and bar gauges that find their range from the data: true ranges each field by its own values, false (the default) by the values of every field shown. Other panels already range each field by its own values.

width.description: A table column's fixed width in pixels; absent means the column shares the remaining width. Only table panels draw it.

minWidth.description: The least width in pixels a table column shrinks to. Only table panels draw it.

align.description: Where a table column puts its header and cells; auto right-aligns numbers and left-aligns the rest. Only table panels draw it.

filterable.description: Adds a value filter to the table column's header. Only table panels draw it.

inspect.description: Adds a button to every cell of the table column that opens its value in a dialog. Only table panels draw it.

hideHeader.description: Hides the text of the table column's header; screen readers still read it. Only table panels draw it.

cell.description: How a table column draws its cells; absent means the plain cell with colors from thresholds and colored mappings. Only table panels draw it.

intervalFactor.description: Grafana's resolution 1/N: the query's step is multiplied by N.

exemplar.description: Prometheus only: also fetch exemplars for this range query and mark them on the chart.

panelQuery.title: PanelQuery
panelQuery.description: ref defaults to A, B, C by position; datasource defaults to the panel's.

expressionQuery.title: ExpressionQuery
expressionQuery.description: A server-side expression the query proxy evaluates over other queries of the same panel; it has no datasource and its ref is required so references stay stable.

math.description: Arithmetic over query refs written $A or ${A}, such as $A * 2 or abs($A) / $B.

mode.description: How non-number values are treated; strict (the default) reduces a series holding one to NaN.

replaceWith.description: The number that replaces non-number values; required with replaceNonNumbers and refused otherwise.

params.description: One number for gt and lt, a lower and an upper number for the range evaluators.

dashboardQuery.title: DashboardQuery
dashboardQuery.description: Reuses the results of another data panel of this dashboard (Grafana's -- Dashboard -- source); a panel that has one has exactly this query and no datasource, interval, maxDataPoints, timeFrom or timeShift of its own.

panel.description: The id of the data panel whose results are reused; it must not itself reuse another panel or repeat.

withTransforms.description: Apply the source panel's transforms to its results before this panel's own.

expr.description: field_or_number op field_or_number, op one of + - * /.

footerFields.description: Limits the footer to the columns with these field names; absent means every number column.

footerCountRows.description: Adds a footer row with the number of rows.

cellHeight.description: The height of a table row: sm is the compact row, md and lg add padding.

pagination.description: Shows the rows in pages sized to the panel, with previous and next buttons.

frozenColumns.description: The number of columns from the left that stay in view while the table scrolls sideways.

sortBy.description: The name of the column the table starts sorted by.

sortDesc.description: Sorts the starting sort from the largest value down.

typeIcons.description: Shows an icon for the column type before each header.

colorMode.description: scheme colors the cells with colorScheme; opacity varies the opacity of colorFill. Absent means opacity.

colorSteps.description: Number of distinct colors in scheme mode; absent means a continuous ramp.

colorExponent.description: Exponent of an exponential colorScale; 0.5 when absent.

colorFill.description: The color whose opacity varies in opacity mode; absent means the first series color.

legend.description: Whether the color scale is shown under the chart; bottom when absent.

hideBelow.description: Cells with a value at or below this are not drawn; 0 when absent.

hideAbove.description: Cells with a value at or above this are not drawn.

showValues.description: Whether cells carry their value as text: auto only where it fits, always, or never (the default).

xBuckets.description: How calculate groups time into columns: size is seconds per column and count is the number of columns; without a value the size is the data step and the count is one column per sample time. Absent keeps one column per sample time.

yBuckets.description: How calculate groups values into rows: size is the value range of a row (the exponent step on a log scale) and count is the number of rows; without a value the size is a round step that gives about 16 rows and the count is 16. Absent means 16 rows.

yBucketScale.description: Spacing of calculated rows; absent follows yScale.

yBucketLogBase.description: Base of a logarithmic yBucketScale; 2 when absent.

rowsLayout.description: How pre-bucketed series are read: le takes each bound as the upper edge of its row, ge as the lower edge, unknown draws one ordinary row per series, and auto uses le for series with an le label.

yUnit.description: Unit of the row labels; absent uses the field's unit.

yMin.description: Rows that end at or below this value are not drawn.

yMax.description: Rows that start at or above this value are not drawn.

yReverse.description: Draws the lowest row at the top.

yAxis.description: Side of the row labels; left when absent.

yAxisWidth.description: Width of the row labels in pixels; absent fits the longest label.

tooltip.description: single shows the hovered cell, all lists every row of its column, hidden shows no tooltip; single when absent.

tooltipHistogram.description: Adds a small histogram of the hovered column's rows to the tooltip.

tooltipColorScale.description: Adds the color scale to the tooltip with a marker at the hovered value.

exemplars.description: Whether the exemplars of queries that ask for them are drawn; true when absent.

exemplarColor.description: The color of exemplar diamonds; absent means the foreground color.

spanSearch.description: Spans match when this text, in any case, appears in their service, operation, id, attribute keys or attribute values.

serviceNames.description: Spans match when their service is one of these names, or none of them with excludeServices.

excludeServices.description: Spans match when their service is not one of serviceNames.

spanNames.description: Spans match when their operation is one of these names, or none of them with excludeSpanNames.

excludeSpanNames.description: Spans match when their operation is not one of spanNames.

minSpanDuration.description: Spans match when they last at least this many milliseconds.

maxSpanDuration.description: Spans match when they last at most this many milliseconds.

matchesOnly.description: Shows only the spans that match the search, service, operation and duration filters; otherwise the other spans are dimmed.

criticalPathOnly.description: Shows only the spans on the critical path, the chain of spans that decides how long the trace takes.

id.description: Stable across versions; comments anchor to it.

titleHidden.description: Keep the title as the panel's name for menus and screen readers but do not show it. Absent means shown.

id.description: Stable across versions; comments anchor to it.

mode.description: markdown (default): Markdown with sanitized inline HTML. html: sanitized HTML. code: the content shown as code. The agent never writes HTML.

id.description: Stable across versions; comments anchor to it.

placeholderPanel.title: PlaceholderPanel
placeholderPanel.description: Written only by the importer for a Grafana panel we cannot render yet; the agent may move or delete it but not create one.

id.description: Stable across versions; comments anchor to it.

rowPanel.title: RowPanel
rowPanel.description: Child panels are always nested, collapsed or not.

fieldName.title: FieldName
fieldName.description: A field name or series name in the panel's frames.

canvasColor.title: CanvasColor
canvasColor.description: A color, or field to take the bound field's threshold or mapping color.

httpsUrl.description: An https address whose host is written out; ${var} references may appear only after the host.

dashlistPanel.title: DashlistPanel
dashlistPanel.description: Links to other dashboards on this server; no datasource or queries.

id.description: Stable across versions; comments anchor to it.

newsPanel.title: NewsPanel
newsPanel.description: The latest items of one RSS or Atom feed, fetched by the server for allowlisted domains; no datasource or queries.

id.description: Stable across versions; comments anchor to it.

feedUrl.description: An https RSS or Atom feed URL. The server fetches it only when its domain is on the outbound allowlist.
